sources.title: Termination of Employment — Notice to Payroll
workflow_inference: Historical termination processing bundled payroll, benefits and retirement shutdown into a single HR-to-payroll control form.
The form required Benefits Manager preparation and Executive Director approval.
Provider-specific Abacus fields prove this exact version is historical and should not be reused without current-version review.

sources.title: RTEC Direct Deposit Form
workflow_inference: Historical direct-deposit setup was a signed paper form plus supporting bank document.
The form text says RTEC requires direct deposit, aligning with the 2017 and 2025 handbook requirement.
Current HR-GUI reference library contains a newer revision labeled Rev 03-24; therefore the 2020 attachment is a historical form version, not the current template.

scanner_implications: Treat the 2020 forms as historical version/fingerprint evidence only.
Current form recognition should prefer reviewed HR-GUI reference versions and effective dates.
Termination Notice to Payroll should be a canonical form type rather than an unmapped generic termination document.
